'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Scott Lingrell LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Day 2 Light sheet has a blank name box. Listed here as Scott Lingrell from the adjacent Dark Linsanity sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
